## Description

Splits the report at the line "You are starting *PartB*." into a Part A and a Part B file and commits both ("Added split report"). Existing part files are overwritten. When the marker line is missing, it stops with an error. At the end it sources [00_prepare_aux.sh](#help-00_prepare_aux).

## Usage

```bash
./automations/51_split-parts.sh [report [partA [partB]]]
```

- `report` - Report to split (default: `REPLICATION.md`).
- `partA`, `partB` - Output names (default: `<report>-PartA.md` and `<report>-PartB.md`).
- `-h` - Show help.

### Environment Variables

- `jiraticket` - When set, commit messages start with `<jiraticket> #comment [skip ci]`; otherwise with `[skip ci]`.
